terms.While Desert Rift is active, End-If's sw: 沙漠裂隙开放期间，终焉之界挥舞时留下的轨迹会变成沙色。

terms.While the discs are away, normal and hea: 圆盘飞出期间，普通攻击和重攻击会变为短程风刃，造成一半伤害，并可击中上方或下方的敌人。
terms.While you hold this wand, Rafoie, Rabart: 手持此法杖时，炎狱术、极冰术和雷爆术可无视敌人30%的抗性。
terms.With the catalyst complete, use the spec: 完成催化后，在圆盘追击敌人时再次使用特殊攻击，可令两个圆盘飞向锁定目标；若未锁定目标，则飞向前方最近的敌人。圆盘会在那里化作旋风，持续5秒，每秒攻击周围敌人两次，然后飞回。
terms.With the catalyst, normal and heavy atta: 完成催化后，普通攻击和重攻击会以全威力射出3支追踪箭，优先追踪首领和大型敌人。箭矢还会击碎箱子，并且不再爆炸。
terms.With the El Dorado set: gold claws and a: 黄金国套装效果：金色利爪和金色的相互蝶切。每次斩击都会留下持续5秒、威力为10%的旋转残影；每次连击挥斩都会留下持续5秒、威力为10%的空间裂痕，最多同时存在3道。每道残影或裂痕最多击中5名敌人，且不会令敌人踉跄。
terms.Works for a HUnewearl holding Nei's Claw: 新人类女战士持有真·妮之爪或双妮爪时生效；未持有其中任一把爪时，此效果无效。
terms.Worn together with the El Dorado Armor:: 与黄金国铠甲同时装备时，在战斗区域中角色周身会显现一道金色光环。
与黄金国铠甲同时装备时，可无视种族、性别和武器属性要求，装备本职业能够使用的任意武器。
与黄金国铠甲同时装备时，此盾牌提供防御力+150、回避力+150、命中率+5（成套时合计防御力+300、回避力+300、命中率+10），并使成套法术伤害提高15%。
terms.Worn together with the El Dorado Shield:: 与黄金国之盾同时装备时，在战斗区域中角色周身会显现一道金色光环。
与黄金国之盾同时装备时，可无视种族、性别和武器属性要求，装备本职业能够使用的任意武器。
与黄金国之盾同时装备时，此铠甲提供防御力+150、回避力+150、命中率+5（成套时合计防御力+300、回避力+300、命中率+10），并使成套法术伤害提高15%。
terms.Worn together with the Forbidden Armor:: 与禁忌铠甲同时装备时，法术伤害提高15%。
terms.Worn together with the Forbidden Shield:: 与禁忌之盾同时装备时，法术伤害提高15%。
terms.Worn with Morning Glory or Morning Litur: 与晨曦之荣光或晨祷同时装备时，攻击速度提高40%。
terms.Worn with Morning Prayer: +40% attack sp: 与黎明祈求同时装备时，攻击速度提高40%。
terms.Worn with Rika's Claw or Twin Rika Claws: 与里卡之爪或双莉可爪同时装备时，命中率提高15点。
与里卡之爪或双莉可爪同时装备时，雷霆特殊攻击中的群雷术等级提高5级；被其击中的敌人会触电10秒，每0.5秒受到一次群雷术30%威力的伤害。每2秒还会向附近敌人弹射一次全威力群雷术。对触电敌人使用普通攻击或重攻击时，两种效果会同时触发；群雷术命中的敌人雷抗降低40%，持续60秒。
terms.Your Mag's PB-full trigger always activa: 装备融合遗产时，玛古的PB蓄满触发效果必定发动；未装备时触发率为25%。手持ＳＳＰＮ或Ｌ＆Ｋ３８ 战场之狼时，触发率降低15%。
terms.Zonde leaves a field of lightning around: 闪电术会在目标周围生成持续10秒的雷电场。场内每名敌人每0.5秒受到一次相当于闪电术单次伤害20%的雷击。
terms.Boxes in Crater East: 陨石坑周边（东部路线）的箱子
terms.Boxes in Crater North: 陨石坑周边（北部路线）的箱子
terms.Boxes in Crater South: 陨石坑周边（南部路线）的箱子
terms.Boxes in Crater West: 陨石坑周边（西部路线）的箱子

terms.Its special attack casts Anti Lv.7 on yo: 特殊攻击会消耗施放状态术所需的TP，对自己和附近队友施放Lv.7状态术。

001000.name: 贯穿波
description: 特殊攻击波造成普通攻击1.8倍的伤害，命中率与普通攻击相同。

source.name: Piercing wave
description: Its special wave deals 1.8x normal-attack damage with normal-attack accuracy.

001D00.name: 圣光迸发
description: 特殊攻击（30 TP）：以你已学会的圣光术等级及精神力，对目标施放圣光术。必须已学会圣光术。
命中后会向四周发射8道穿透光束，飞行160单位；光束以圣光术的威力各击中沿途敌人一次。连击的任何阶段均可使用此特殊攻击。

source.name: Grants burst
description: Special (30 TP) casts Grants on your target at your learned Grants level and MST. You need Grants learned.
When it hits, it bursts into 8 piercing light rays in a full circle that travel 160 units and hit each other enemy once with the Grants' power. The special can be used at any step of a combo.

001E00.name: 神罚
description: 神罚可无视敌人30%的光属性抗性，但不会改变敌人的弱点属性。
使用神圣滤镜后，神罚可在任何节拍时刻使用，并保留强化等级和属性百分比。

source.name: Divine Punishment
description: Divine Punishment ignores 30% of an enemy's Light resistance; weaknesses are unchanged.
A Divine Filter makes Divine Punishment usable at every beat time and keeps grind and percentages.

001F00.name: 拉维斯波
description: 特殊攻击波可飞行100单位，造成普通攻击2倍的伤害，命中率与普通攻击相同。

source.name: Lavis wave
description: Its special wave travels 100 units and deals 2x normal-attack damage with normal-attack accuracy.

003000.name: 十二向拉维斯波
description: 特殊攻击会向12个方向发射拉维斯波，最远飞行300单位。
其中4道主波可贯穿目标，最多击中10个目标；每次命中造成普通攻击1.2倍的伤害，命中率与普通攻击相同。其余8道波不造成伤害。

source.name: Twelve-way Lavis waves
description: Its special fires Lavis waves in 12 directions out to 300 units.
The four main waves pierce and hit up to 10 targets for 1.2x normal-attack damage each, with normal-attack accuracy; the other eight do no damage.

003800.name: 拉维斯波
description: 特殊攻击波可飞行200单位，造成普通攻击1.5倍的伤害，命中率与普通攻击相同。

source.name: Lavis wave
description: Its special wave travels 200 units and deals 1.5x normal-attack damage with normal-attack accuracy.

004B00.name: 贯穿齐射
description: 每次成功击中敌人都会恢复最大HP的1%（向上取整），特殊攻击命中也会触发。
特殊攻击：子弹可飞行210单位并贯穿目标，沿狭窄直线最多击中10名敌人，每次命中造成一次重攻击伤害；自身不消耗HP。

source.name: Piercing volley
description: Every landed hit on an enemy restores 1% of maximum HP, rounded up, special hits included.
Special: its bullets reach 210 units and pierce, hitting up to 10 enemies in a narrow line, each with a heavy-attack hit. It takes no HP from enemies.

005100.name: 巨型死咒术
description: 普通攻击和重攻击会改为发射Lv.30死咒术，而非近战命中。死咒术会附着在敌人身上5秒，连续命中10次；每次命中恢复最大TP的1%（重攻击命中恢复2%）。同一敌人最多附着3枚。
特殊攻击（40 TP）：发射巨型Lv.30死咒术，以每秒16单位的速度向前漂移，持续10秒，遇墙停止。范围内每名敌人每秒受到两次攻击，每次攻击均有Lv.30的即死判定。再次使用特殊攻击会替换现有巨型死咒术。

source.name: Giant Megid
description: Normal and heavy attacks fire a Lv.30 Megid instead of a melee hit. It sticks to the enemy for 5 seconds and hits it 10 times, each hit restoring 1% of maximum TP (2% from a heavy attack). Up to 3 can stick to one enemy.

Special (40 TP): a giant Lv.30 Megid drifts forward at 16 units per second for 10 seconds, stopping at walls. It hits each enemy inside it twice a second, each time with a Lv.30 instant-kill chance. Using the special again replaces it.

006000.name: 三向火球术
description: 每次普通攻击或重攻击命中时，还会以你当前的精神力发射一道Lv.20火球术，威力为20%。
特殊攻击会扇形发射3道Lv.20火球术，彼此间隔15度，威力为全额；每次挥击消耗最大TP的7%。

source.name: Three-way Foie
description: Each normal and heavy hit also fires a Lv.20 Foie using your MST at 20% power.
Special fires three Lv.20 Foie in a fan, 15 degrees apart, at full power for 7% of maximum TP per swing.

006700.name: 追踪齐射
description: 装备机甲堡垒外壳时：命中率+20，伤害提高20%，且远距离攻击不会损失命中率。
之后发射的4枚火箭会追踪敌人，并优先分散攻击不同目标。火箭最多飞行450单位，遇墙停止。
同一轮齐射中命中同一敌人的火箭，按命中顺序分别造成100%、50%、25%和12.5%的伤害。

source.name: Homing volley
description: With Baranz Cladding equipped: +20 ATA, 20% more damage, and no accuracy loss over distance.
Its four rockets then home in on enemies, spreading over different enemies first. They fly up to 450 units and stop at walls.
Rockets of one volley that reach the same enemy deal 100%, 50%, 25% and 12.5% damage, in the order they land.

006D00.name: 双重群雷术
description: 每次射击都会先发射一道精神力固定为1280的群雷术（不使用你的精神力数值），并在0.12秒后再发射一道。

source.name: Double Gizonde
description: Each shot fires a Gizonde with a fixed 1280 MST instead of yours, then a second one 0.12 seconds later.

008F00.name: 弗罗文套装
description: 同时装备弗罗文之铠、弗罗文之盾和任意一把弗罗文大剑（原版、所有带日期的复制版或真品）时：每件装备自身的属性提高50%；大剑的攻击力与命中率、铠甲和盾牌的防御力与回避力均会提高。

source.name: Flowen set
description: Worn with Flowen's Frame, Flowen's Shield and any Flowen's Sword (the original, every dated replica or True): each piece's own stats are raised by 50%, the sword's ATP and ATA and the Frame's and the Shield's DFP and EVP.

009600.name: TP波
description: 特殊攻击波的命中率与普通攻击相同；每名被击中的敌人都会恢复最大TP的7%。

source.name: TP wave
description: Its special wave uses normal-attack accuracy, and each enemy it hits restores 7% of maximum TP.

009900.name: 贯穿之心
description: 特殊攻击：发射一颗大型爱心，沿直线飞行最远280单位并贯穿敌人，遇墙停止。
爱心经过的每个敌人碰撞体积都会受到一次重攻击威力和命中率的伤害，因此多部位首领的每个部位都会被击中；箱子也会被击碎。
被爱心击中的敌人会陷入混乱（混乱效果），免疫该状态的敌人（如首领）除外。爱心飞行时会留下粉色闪光和白色羽毛。

source.name: Piercing heart
description: Special: fires a large heart that flies straight for up to 280 units, passing through enemies. A wall stops it.
Every enemy hitbox it passes takes one hit with heavy-attack power and accuracy, so each part of a multi-part boss is hit. Boxes break too.
Every enemy it wounds is confused (Chaos), unless it is immune, as bosses are. A trail of pink sparkles and white feathers follows the heart.

009B00.name: 贯穿销魂光束
description: 特殊攻击会向目标发射一道浅粉色光束，最远345单位；未锁定目标时则直线发射。光束遇墙停止。
光束会贯穿最多5名敌人或箱子，按由近及远的顺序造成普通攻击1.75倍伤害，命中率与普通攻击相同。
每次射击消耗最大TP的5%，并且需要有足够TP。
每次命中都会恢复最大HP的1%，包括特殊攻击命中。

source.name: Piercing Spirit beam
description: Special fires a light pink beam up to 345 units long at your target, or straight ahead without one, and the beam stops at walls.
It pierces up to 5 enemies or boxes, nearest first, dealing 1.75x normal-attack damage with normal-attack accuracy.
Each shot costs 5% of maximum TP and needs that much TP.
Every hit, the special's included, restores 1% of maximum HP.

009D00.name: 波浪冲击
description: 特殊攻击会发射5道贯穿波，每道造成普通攻击伤害的85%；可在连击中使用。
每次特殊攻击挥击消耗最大HP的10%；当前HP高于该数值时即可使用，包括满HP状态。

source.name: Wave crash
description: Special fires five piercing waves, each dealing 85% of normal-attack damage, and it can be used in combos.
Each special swing costs 10% of maximum HP and works at any HP above that, full HP included.

009E00.name: 持续弹体
description: 特殊弹体每0.3秒对其接触到的每名敌人造成一次普通攻击伤害；可在连击中使用。
每次普通攻击命中敌人会恢复最大HP的1%；每次重攻击命中会恢复2%。

source.name: Sustained projectile
description: Its special projectile hits every enemy it touches every 0.3 seconds for normal-attack damage, and the special can be used in combos.
Each normal-attack hit on an enemy restores 1% of maximum HP; each heavy-attack hit restores 2%.

009F00.name: 元素穿透冷却重置
description: 普通攻击和重攻击与普通长杖相同：最多击中2个目标，并像其他长杖一样恢复TP；不会发射激光。
特殊攻击（仅魔法师职业）：消耗当前TP的一半，重置元素穿透技能的冷却时间。该技能有独立的10秒冷却时间，且不能在连击中使用。
此效果不会使你陷入冰冻、混乱或麻痹。

source.name: Elemental Bypass reset
description: Normal and heavy attacks are those of an ordinary rod: they hit up to 2 targets and restore TP like other rods. It fires no lasers.
Special (Force classes): resets your Elemental Bypass cooldown for half your current TP. It has its own 10-second cooldown and cannot be used in a combo.
It never freezes, confuses or paralyzes you.

00AC00.name: 黄金国波刃
description: 同时穿戴黄金国铠甲和黄金国之盾时：挥剑动作与攻击距离不变，剑刃长度变为1.4倍，并带有金色描边。
穿戴套装时，每次普通攻击或重攻击挥斩还会向前发射一道扁平剑气。剑气可贯穿路径上最多5名敌人和箱子，造成该次挥斩一半的伤害；挥斩本身仍会命中。
穿戴套装时，特殊攻击消耗最大HP的15%（HP不高于该值时无法使用），并以扇形发射5道金色暗黑弗罗文大剑波刃，伤害与暗黑弗罗文大剑相同。
装备特拉西斯玛古时，攻击速度提高40%，无论是否穿戴套装均生效。

source.name: El Dorado waves
description: With El Dorado Armor and El Dorado Shield worn: sword motions and reach, and a blade 1.4 times longer with a gold outline.
With the set, each normal or heavy swing also sends a flat sword beam forward. It pierces up to 5 enemies and boxes in its path for half the swing's damage, and the swing's own hit still lands.
With the set, its special costs 15% of maximum HP (not usable at or below that) and fires five golden Dark Flow waves in a fan with Dark Flow's damage.
With the Tellusis Mag: +40% attack speed, with or without the set.

00B000.name: 神罚
description: 每次特殊攻击射击都会在任意节拍时刻对房间内最多5个目标（敌人或首领部位）降下红色神罚。
每次射击至少命中3次；对同一个首领最多只能命中3次。
神罚可无视敌人30%的光属性抗性，伤害比其他神罚武器高25%。
神圣滤镜可保留强化等级和属性百分比，但不再改变特殊攻击效果。

source.name: Divine Punishment
description: Every special shot calls red Divine Punishments on up to 5 targets anywhere in the room, enemies or a boss's body parts, at every beat time.
Each shot strikes at least 3 times, and no more than 3 of its strikes land on one boss.
Divine Punishment ignores 30% of an enemy's Light resistance and deals 25% more damage than on the other Divine Punishment weapons.
A Divine Filter keeps grind and percentages. It no longer changes how the special works.

00BF00.name: 神罚
description: 神罚可无视敌人30%的光属性抗性；必须装备冲击部件玛古。
神圣滤镜可使特殊攻击在任何节拍时刻使用，并保留强化等级和属性百分比；仍须装备冲击部件玛古。

source.name: Divine Punishment
description: Divine Punishment ignores 30% of an enemy's Light resistance and needs a Striker Unit Mag equipped.
A Divine Filter makes it usable at every beat time and keeps grind and percentages; the Striker Unit is still needed.

008C10.name: 召唤机甲堡垒·改
description: 普通攻击（仅魔法师职业）会在你身旁召唤一台友方机甲堡垒·改，或派它攻击你指定的敌人。它拥有极限难度机甲堡垒·改的属性，并使用机甲堡垒·改自身的攻击方式作战。
它会跟随你，并持续攻击房间内最近的敌人，直到被击败或你切换区域。被击败后，3秒即可再次召唤。每台召唤机甲头上都会显示HP条；如果它挡住角色视线，会半透明显示。

source.name: Baranz summon
description: Normal attack (Forces only) summons an ally Baranz beside you, or sends it at the enemy you target. It has an Ultimate Baranz's stats and fights with Baranz's own attacks.

It follows you and fights the nearest enemy in the room until it is defeated or you change area. After a defeat you can summon again in 3 seconds. An HP bar shows over every summon, and a summon that blocks your view of your character turns half transparent.

001101.name: 双重死咒术
description: 每次特殊攻击挥击会先后发射两发Lv.20死咒术，间隔极短；每发最多贯穿5名敌人。每次挥击消耗最大HP的2%。
每发死咒术对敌人造成一次Lv.20即死判定。若即死未触发，则造成你与敌人防御力差值的20%伤害，且该次攻击至少会使敌人剩余1点HP。

source.name: Twin Megid
description: Each special swing fires two Lv.20 Megids, a moment apart, each piercing up to 5 enemies. It costs 2% of maximum HP.
Each Megid hits an enemy once with a Lv.20 instant-kill chance. If the kill fails, it deals 20% of the gap between your ATP and the enemy's DFP, and that hit always leaves at least 1 HP.

001501.name: 贯穿火球术连射
description: 按住特殊攻击最多2秒，每0.2秒发射一发Lv.20火球术。发射时可转向或跟随锁定目标，且不能在连击中使用。
每发火球术使用固定精神力270，威力为70%，飞行300单位，并可贯穿最多3名敌人或箱子，依次造成100%、50%和25%的伤害。
命中的敌人会燃烧10秒；再次命中会刷新燃烧持续时间。

source.name: Piercing Foie barrage
description: Hold the special to fire a Lv.20 Foie every 0.2 seconds for up to 2 seconds. You can turn or follow a locked target while firing, and the special cannot be used in a combo.
Each Foie uses a fixed 270 MST at 70% power, flies 300 units and pierces up to 3 enemies or boxes for 100%, 50% and 25% damage.
Hits set enemies on fire for 10 seconds, and further hits refresh the burn.

006D01.name: 双重群雷术
description: 每次射击都会先发射一道精神力固定为1500的群雷术（不使用你的精神力数值），并在0.12秒后再发射一道。

source.name: Double Gizonde
description: Each shot fires a Gizonde with a fixed 1500 MST instead of yours, then a second one 0.12 seconds later.

008F01.name: 弗罗文套装
description: 同时装备弗罗文之铠、弗罗文之盾和任意一把弗罗文大剑（原版、所有带日期的复制版或真品）时：每件装备自身的属性提高50%；大剑的攻击力与命中率、铠甲和盾牌的防御力与回避力均会提高。

source.name: Flowen set
description: Worn with Flowen's Frame, Flowen's Shield and any Flowen's Sword (the original, every dated replica or True): each piece's own stats are raised by 50%, the sword's ATP and ATA and the Frame's and the Shield's DFP and EVP.

003601.name: 环刃投掷
description: 特殊攻击会同时投出两枚圆盘。它们会追击你周围120单位内的敌人，持续20秒；每枚圆盘优先攻击不同敌人。附近没有敌人时会击碎箱子，随后飞回。
每枚圆盘命中造成普通攻击1.25倍的伤害，命中率与普通攻击相同；同一枚圆盘每隔0.5秒可再次击中同一敌人。
两枚圆盘全部飞回前无法攻击，且此特殊攻击不能在连击中使用。

source.name: Chakram throw
description: Special throws both discs. They hunt enemies within 120 units of you for 20 seconds, each preferring a different enemy and breaking boxes when no enemy is near, then fly back.
Each disc hit deals 1.25x normal-attack damage with normal-attack accuracy, and a disc can hit the same enemy again after 0.5 seconds.
You cannot attack until both discs return, and the special cannot be used in a combo.

00C001.name: 集束火箭
description: 普通攻击和重攻击会沿固定弧线向正前方发射一枚火箭，不会追踪目标。
火箭飞至弧线顶点（前方约60单位处）或撞墙时，会炸裂成5枚子弹，随机落在爆点周围10至40单位范围内。
每枚子弹最多击中5名敌人或箱子，造成该次攻击一半的伤害。该武器的持握和发射方式与散弹枪相同，不能连击，也没有特殊攻击。

source.name: Cluster rocket
description: Normal and heavy attacks fire one rocket on a fixed arc straight ahead. It does not home.
At the top of the arc, about 60 units ahead, or when it hits a wall, it bursts into 5 bomblets that land at random spots 10 to 40 units around that point.
Each bomblet hits up to 5 enemies or boxes for half the attack's damage. It is held and fired like a Shot, cannot combo and has no special attack.

006C01.name: 美塞塔子弹
description: 仅限普通攻击。轻按会从交替枪口发射10枚美塞塔子弹；按住则以每秒25发的速度持续射击，直到美塞塔耗尽。每发子弹消耗10美塞塔，造成普通攻击80%的伤害，且不会使敌人踉跄。
子弹以每秒480单位的速度直线飞行，并会围绕瞄准方向随机散射：左右最多偏18度、上下最多偏6度。射程比机枪远10单位，因此可能射偏。
同时装备黄金国铠甲和黄金国之盾时，每发子弹可贯穿最多3名敌人，依次造成100%、50%和25%的伤害；遇箱子则停止。

source.name: Meseta bullets
description: Normal attack only. A tap fires 10 Meseta bullets from alternating muzzles, and holding keeps firing at 25 bullets per second until your Meseta runs out. Each bullet costs 10 Meseta and deals 80% of normal-attack damage without making the enemy flinch.
Bullets fly straight at 480 units per second with random spread around your aim, up to 18 degrees sideways and 6 degrees up or down, and reach 10 units past Mechgun range, so they can miss.
With El Dorado Armor and El Dorado Shield worn, each bullet pierces up to 3 enemies for 100%, 50% and 25% damage; a box stops it.

006A01.name: 蓄力旋转扫击
description: 按住普通攻击或重攻击1秒后松开：角色会在0.8秒内旋转3圈，向周围整圈射出36发子弹，并向前滑行最多45单位。每圈中，手枪射程内的每名敌人或箱子最多受到一次普通攻击命中。
蓄力时可以移动和翻滚。按住不超过0.2秒会发射普通子弹；按住0.2至1秒后松开则取消蓄力。
自带攻击速度+20%，可与攻速插件叠加；没有特殊攻击。

source.name: Charged spin sweep
description: Hold Normal or Heavy for 1 second, then release: you spin three times in 0.8 seconds, firing 36 shots in a full circle while sliding up to 45 units forward. Each enemy or box within Handgun range takes at most one normal-attack hit per spin.
You can move and roll while charging. A tap of up to 0.2 seconds fires a normal shot, and releasing between 0.2 and 1 second cancels the charge.
Built-in +20% attack speed adds to attack-speed units. It has no special attack.

001E01.name: 神罚
description: 神罚可无视敌人30%的光属性抗性，但不会改变敌人的弱点属性。
神罚可在任何节拍时刻使用。

source.name: Divine Punishment
description: Divine Punishment ignores 30% of an enemy's Light resistance; weaknesses are unchanged.
Divine Punishment is usable at every beat time.

00BF01.name: 神罚
description: 神罚可无视敌人30%的光属性抗性。
神罚可在任何节拍时刻使用，但仍须装备冲击部件玛古。

source.name: Divine Punishment
description: Divine Punishment ignores 30% of an enemy's Light resistance.
It is usable at every beat time but still needs a Striker Unit Mag equipped.

00B001.name: 神罚
description: 每次特殊攻击射击都会在任意节拍时刻，对房间内最多5个目标（敌人或首领部位）降下红色神罚。
每次射击至少命中3次；对同一个首领最多只能命中3次。
神罚可无视敌人30%的光属性抗性，伤害比其他神罚武器高25%。

source.name: Divine Punishment
description: Every special shot calls red Divine Punishments on up to 5 targets anywhere in the room, enemies or a boss's body parts, at every beat time.
Each shot strikes at least 3 times, and no more than 3 of its strikes land on one boss.
Divine Punishment ignores 30% of an enemy's Light resistance and deals 25% more damage than on the other Divine Punishment weapons.

00DD01.name: 三目标挥击
description: 无论锻造成哪种外形，每次攻击最多可触及3名敌人。

source.name: 3-target swings
description: Each attack reaches up to 3 enemies, whichever model you forge.

00E701.name: 双重打击
description: 每次攻击最多可触及2名敌人；斧型外观最多可触及3名敌人。

source.name: Twin strikes
description: Each attack reaches up to 2 enemies; the Axe model reaches up to 3.

00EB01.name: 三束齐射
description: 每次攻击都会发射3发子弹：一发直射，两发分别向左右偏约12度，射程170单位，每发瞄准各自的目标。光子部件和子弹会闪烁变幻的彩虹色。

source.name: Three-ray volley
description: Every attack fires three bullets, straight ahead and about 12 degrees to each side, out to 170 units, each aimed at its own target. Its photon parts and bullets glow in shifting rainbow colours.

00EA01.name: 远程射击
description: 射击可达210单位，每发子弹命中一名敌人。光子部件和子弹会闪烁变幻的彩虹色。

source.name: Long-range shots
description: Shots reach 210 units and hit one enemy each. Its photon parts and bullets glow in shifting rainbow colours.

00EC01.name: 元素强化
description: 火、冰、雷系法术（火球术、冻气术和闪电术系列）造成的伤害提高10%。

source.name: Elemental boost
description: Fire, ice and lightning techniques (the Foie, Barta and Zonde lines) deal 10% more damage.

001B01.name: 双重追踪射击
description: 每次普通攻击、重攻击和特殊攻击都会快速连续发射两发子弹；每发子弹分别进行一次独立命中判定。
每发子弹都会转向追踪瞄准的敌人。未锁定目标时，或子弹被墙壁挡住时，子弹会直线飞行。

source.name: Double homing shot
description: Every normal, heavy and special attack fires two shots in quick succession, each a separate hit with its own accuracy roll.
Each shot curves to follow the enemy it was aimed at. A shot with no target, or one blocked by a wall, flies straight.

001402.name: 按住连射
description: 按住特殊攻击时，每0.1秒发射一发子弹，威力等同普通攻击；子弹瞄准锁定目标，未锁定时则直线射出。发射时可以转向。
每发子弹最多击中射线路径上的第一个敌人或箱子，射程可达300单位，且不能贯穿。
每发子弹的命中率与普通攻击相同，不消耗HP。该武器无法衔接连击：普通攻击、重攻击或特殊攻击之后都不能接续其他攻击，每次都要重新起手。
普通攻击和重攻击无法用精准防御、翻滚或幻影传送取消。
按住特殊攻击会使武器过热。角色旁的过热槽约在连续射击6秒后蓄满；蓄满后武器会停止，直到过热槽重新降空（约12秒）才能再次攻击。
未等过热槽蓄满就松开时，冷却速度会提高至3倍；接近满槽时约4秒即可冷却。换持其他武器时，过热槽仍会保留热量并继续冷却。

source.name: Held rapid fire
description: Hold the special to fire one shot every 0.1 seconds at normal-attack power, aimed at your lock-on target or straight ahead. You can turn while firing.
Each shot hits only the first enemy or box on its line, up to 300 units away, and does not pierce.
Each shot uses normal-attack accuracy and costs no HP. The weapon is combo locked: no attack chains into another, so every normal, heavy or special attack starts on its own.
Its normal and heavy attacks cannot be cancelled with Just Guard, the roll or the Mirage warp.

Holding the special heats the weapon. An overheat gauge beside you fills in about 6 seconds of fire. When it is full the weapon stops and cannot attack at all until the gauge is empty again, about 12 seconds later.
Let go before the gauge is full and it cools three times as fast, about 4 seconds from nearly full. The gauge keeps its heat and keeps cooling while another weapon is in hand.

008F02.name: 弗罗文套装
description: 同时装备弗罗文之铠、弗罗文之盾和任意一把弗罗文大剑（原版、所有带日期的复制版或真品）时：每件装备自身的属性提高50%；大剑的攻击力与命中率、铠甲和盾牌的防御力与回避力均会提高。

source.name: Flowen set
description: Worn with Flowen's Frame, Flowen's Shield and any Flowen's Sword (the original, every dated replica or True): each piece's own stats are raised by 50%, the sword's ATP and ATA and the Frame's and the Shield's DFP and EVP.

00E802.name: 彩虹光辉
description: 光子部件和子弹会闪烁变幻的彩虹色；所有职业使用该武器时，动作都与人类女枪手使用手枪时相同。

source.name: Rainbow glow
description: Its photon parts and bullets glow in shifting rainbow colours, and every class fires it with RAmarl's handgun motion.

001102.name: 死咒挥击
description: 每次特殊攻击挥击都会发射一发Lv.25死咒术，最多贯穿5名敌人。连击第一段包含两次挥击，因此会发射两发。
若死咒术未能即死，则以你的攻击力（人类男魔法师和人类女魔法师使用精神力）对敌人的防御力造成伤害；该次命中至少会使敌人剩余1点HP。
装备黑犬护卫时，挥击动作变为双头剑动作；每次特殊攻击挥击会向你周围均匀发射10发死咒术，每发最多贯穿5名敌人。

source.name: Megid swings
description: Each special swing fires one Lv.25 Megid that pierces up to 5 enemies. The first combo step has two swings, so it fires two.
If a Megid fails to kill, it deals damage from your ATP (MST for FOmar and FOmarl) against the enemy's DFP, and that hit always leaves at least 1 HP.
With Black Hound Guard equipped, it swings with double saber motions and each special swing fires 10 Megids evenly around you, each piercing up to 5 enemies.

008B03.name: 紫色音波
description: 会同时发射紫色弹体和音波。两者的飞行速度均变为原来的2倍，但射程不变，并且合计视为一次攻击，因此每名敌人只会被击中一次。

source.name: Purple sound wave
description: Fires a purple projectile together with its sound wave. Both travel twice as fast over the same range and count as one attack, so each enemy is hit once.

008C03.name: 舞动人偶
description: 5个人偶会绕身飞舞，接触敌人时造成普通攻击伤害；每名敌人每0.5秒最多被击中一次，也能击碎箱子。每个人偶成功命中10次后会消失，每5秒会长出一个新人偶。
普通攻击：人偶散开形成半径40单位的圆环，持续5秒，每0.35秒攻击圆环内所有目标。重攻击：形成半径60单位的圆环，每0.2秒以重攻击威力攻击一次。
圆环出现后，每次继续使用普通攻击或重攻击都会延长5秒，最多延长至剩余30秒；以最近一次攻击决定圆环效果。
散开的人偶会像恶魔之眼的挥击一样拖出红色光带。每次成功击中敌人会恢复1点TP。
装备仁慈护身符时：圆环持续时间额外延长15秒（最多剩余45秒），范围扩大至1.5倍。

source.name: Dancing dolls
description: Its 5 orbiting dolls hit any enemy they touch for normal-attack damage, at most once per enemy every 0.5 seconds, and break boxes. A doll vanishes after 10 landed hits, and a new one grows every 5 seconds.
Normal attack: the dolls spread to a 40-unit ring for 5 seconds and hit everything inside every 0.35 seconds. Heavy attack: a 60-unit ring that hits every 0.2 seconds at heavy-attack power.
Each further normal or heavy attack while the ring is out adds 5 seconds, up to 30 seconds left. The latest attack sets the ring.
The spread dolls trail a red ribbon like Evil Curst's swing. Every landed hit on an enemy restores 1 TP.
With the Benevolent Omamori: the ring lasts 15 seconds longer (up to 45 seconds left) and is 1.5x wider.

008F03.name: 弗罗文套装
description: 同时装备弗罗文之铠、弗罗文之盾和任意一把弗罗文大剑（原版、所有带日期的复制版或真品）时：每件装备自身的属性提高50%；大剑的攻击力与命中率、铠甲和盾牌的防御力与回避力均会提高。

source.name: Flowen set
description: Worn with Flowen's Frame, Flowen's Shield and any Flowen's Sword (the original, every dated replica or True): each piece's own stats are raised by 50%, the sword's ATP and ATA and the Frame's and the Shield's DFP and EVP.

000E03.name: 高耗销金
description: 使用销金特殊攻击时，每次命中消耗1000美塞塔（原为200）；只有持有至少1000美塞塔时才能发动销金。赌场奖品双决斗光剑自带销金特殊攻击。

source.name: Costly Charge
description: With the Charge special, each Charge hit takes 1000 Meseta instead of 200, and Charge only works while you carry at least 1000 Meseta. The casino prize Twin Gladius comes with Charge.

008B04.name: 光束
description: 普通攻击和重攻击会沿地面发射快速光束，射程与步枪相同。光束可贯穿敌人和箱子，遇墙停止，也能击中会挡下枪弹的敌人（例如Satellite Lizards）。
光束沿途的光爆会额外击中最多5名敌人一次，造成光束伤害的50%。重攻击光束还会在地面留下持续2秒的尾迹，每0.25秒造成一次30%伤害。
特殊攻击：以40度扇形发射5发Lv.30冻气术；命中的敌人会被冻结，免疫冰冻的敌人除外。
重攻击和特殊攻击不能衔接连击；装备期间法术伤害提高10%。

source.name: Light beam
description: Normal and heavy attacks fire a fast light beam along the ground out to Rifle range. It pierces enemies and boxes, stops at walls, and can hit enemies that block gunfire, such as Satellite Lizards.
Light bursts along its path hit up to 5 enemies once more for 50% of the beam's damage. Heavy beams also leave a ground wake for 2 seconds that hits every 0.25 seconds for 30%.
Special: five Lv.30 Barta in a 40-degree fan freeze every enemy they hit, unless it is immune.
Heavy and special attacks cannot combo, and your techniques deal 10% more damage while it is equipped.

008F04.name: 弗罗文套装

source.name: Twin slicers

000F05.name: 贯穿拳波
description: 每次普通攻击或重攻击挥拳时，都会向前发射一道扁平白色拳波，射程与投刃相同。
拳波可贯穿目标，每名敌人和每个箱子各受击一次，造成该次攻击最终伤害的50%；拳波遇墙停止。拳头本身仍会照常命中。

source.name: Piercing punch wave
description: Each normal or heavy punch also sends a flat white wave out to Slicer range.
The wave pierces, hitting each enemy and box once for 50% of the attack's final damage, and stops at walls. The punch itself still hits as usual.

008C05.name: 召唤棕狂熊
description: 普通攻击（仅魔法师职业）会在你身旁召唤一只友方棕狂熊，或派它攻击你指定的敌人。它拥有极难难度棕狂熊的属性，并会在近距离挥爪攻击。
它会跟随你，并持续攻击房间内最近的敌人，直到被击败或你切换区域。被击败后，3秒即可再次召唤。每只召唤生物头上都会显示HP条；如果召唤生物挡住角色视线，会半透明显示。

source.name: Booma summon
description: Normal attack (Forces only) summons an ally Booma beside you, or sends it at the enemy you target. It has a Very Hard Booma's stats and claws at close range.

It follows you and fights the nearest enemy in the room until it is defeated or you change area. After a defeat you can summon again in 3 seconds. An HP bar shows over every summon, and a summon that blocks your view of your character turns half transparent.

031025.name: 召唤Meseton
description: 在自由探索模式或翠绿边境中，进入有怪物的普通房间或单人房间后使用：Meseton会立即出现在房间里，并消耗一支笛子。
在其他任务中，或Meseton已在房间里时，使用不会产生效果，笛子也不会消耗。

source.name: Summons Meseton
description: Use it in free roam or the Verdant Frontier, in a normal or solo game, in a room with monsters: Meseton appears in that room at once and one flute is used.
In other quests, or while Meseton is already in the room, nothing happens and the flute is kept.

000F06.name: 火焰伙伴
description: 普通攻击和重攻击会发射火焰弹，火焰弹可穿过敌人并各命中一次，分别造成普通攻击或重攻击威力，也能击碎箱子。
特殊攻击：0.5秒后在你身旁生成一道火焰，持续20秒；再次使用特殊攻击会重新计时。火焰会飞向你周围85单位内最近的敌人；附近没有敌人时则飞向箱子。每0.4秒攻击一次，造成普通攻击一半的伤害。
每次火焰命中敌人会恢复1点TP。装备开拓者象征时会生成两道火焰。

source.name: Flame companion
description: Normal and heavy attacks fire a flame shot that passes through enemies, hitting each once with normal or heavy attack power, and breaks boxes.

Special: after 0.5 seconds a flame appears beside you for 20 seconds; using the special again restarts the time. It flies to the nearest enemy within 85 units of you, or a box when no enemy is near, and hits it every 0.4 seconds for half a normal attack's damage.
Each flame hit on an enemy restores 1 TP. With Trailblazer Symbol equipped: two flames.

0102A6.name: 腕环
description: 在战斗区域中，角色两只手腕上会出现发光的绿色小手环。装备开拓者权能或开拓者权能·降临时，手环会变成紫色，特殊攻击召唤的火焰或光球数量会由一个变为两个。

source.name: Wrist rings
description: A small glowing green bracelet on each wrist in the field. With Trailblazer Exousia or Advent equipped, the bracelets turn purple and the special summons two flames or orbs instead of one.

008C06.name: 召唤紫魔龟
description: 普通攻击（仅魔法师职业）会在你身旁召唤一只友方紫魔龟，或派它攻击你指定的敌人。它拥有极限难度紫魔龟的属性，并会在近距离挥爪攻击。

000F07.name: 光球伙伴
description: 普通攻击和重攻击会发射与开拓者权能相同的贯穿火焰弹。
特殊攻击：0.5秒后在你身旁出现一个发光光球。光球会持续存在，直到你切换区域、卸下武器或被击倒。它会每0.4秒攻击你周围85单位内最近的敌人一次，造成普通攻击一半的伤害。
每次光球命中敌人会恢复1点TP。装备开拓者象征时会生成两个光球。

source.name: Orb companion
description: Normal and heavy attacks fire the same piercing flame shots as Trailblazer Exousia.

Special: after 0.5 seconds a glowing orb appears beside you and stays until you change area, unequip the weapon or are knocked out. It hits the nearest enemy within 85 units of you every 0.4 seconds for half a normal attack's damage.
Each orb hit on an enemy restores 1 TP. With Trailblazer Symbol equipped: two orbs.

008C07.name: 召唤翼龙
description: 普通攻击（仅魔法师职业）会在你身旁召唤一只友方翼龙，或派它攻击你指定的敌人。它拥有极限难度翼龙的属性，并可从最远160单位处发射光束。
敌人进入45单位范围内或翼龙损失四分之一HP时，它会起飞并发射追踪光束；最多每15秒发动一次。
它会跟随你，并持续攻击房间内最近的敌人，直到被击败或你切换区域。被击败后，3秒即可再次召唤。每只召唤生物头上都会显示HP条；如果召唤生物挡住角色视线，会半透明显示。

source.name: Nano Dragon summon
description: Normal attack (Forces only) summons an ally Nano Dragon beside you, or sends it at the enemy you target. With an Ultimate Nano Dragon's stats it fires its beam from up to 160 units.
When an enemy gets within 45 units or it has lost a quarter of its HP, it takes off and fires homing beams, at most once every 15 seconds.

It follows you and fights the nearest enemy in the room until it is defeated or you change area. After a defeat you can summon again in 3 seconds. An HP bar shows over every summon, and a summon that blocks your view of your character turns half transparent.

0102A7.name: 强袭散弹枪配套效果
description: 装备机甲堡垒导弹枪时：命中率+20，强袭散弹枪伤害提高20%，远距离攻击不会损失命中率，追踪火箭对同一敌人造成的伤害依次为100%、50%、25%、12.5%。
在战斗区域中，角色两侧上臂会出现机甲堡垒装甲板。

source.name: Launcher pairing
description: With Baranz Launcher equipped: +20 ATA, 20% more launcher damage, no accuracy loss over distance, and homing rockets that share their damage on one enemy (100%, 50%, 25%, 12.5%).
Baranz armor plates appear on both upper arms in the field.

008F08.name: 弗罗文套装
description: 同时装备弗罗文之铠、弗罗文之盾和任意一把弗罗文大剑（原版、所有带日期的复制版或真品）时：每件装备自身的属性提高50%；大剑的攻击力与命中率、铠甲和盾牌的防御力与回避力均会提高。

source.name: Flowen set
description: Worn with Flowen's Frame, Flowen's Shield and any Flowen's Sword (the original, every dated replica or True): each piece's own stats are raised by 50%, the sword's ATP and ATA and the Frame's and the Shield's DFP and EVP.

000908.name: 蓄力射击 II
description: 普通攻击和重攻击会发射1枚追踪火箭。火箭优先追踪敌人；附近没有敌人时才会追踪箱子。
火箭会在碰到第一个敌人或箱子时爆炸，爆炸最多击中5个敌人或箱子。
重攻击为蓄力射击，会将你向后推。
特殊攻击：蓄力射击 II。发射两枚速度较慢的蓄力追踪火箭，并会将你向后推。不消耗TP，且不能接在普通攻击或重攻击之后发动。
每枚蓄力火箭会贯穿最先碰到的2个敌人或箱子，随后发生大型爆炸，最多再击中5个目标。
蓄力火箭飞行途中还会引发小型爆炸，每次最多击中5个敌人或箱子。

source.name: Charge Shot II
description: Normal and heavy attacks fire one homing rocket. It goes after enemies first, and boxes only when no enemy is near.
The rocket explodes on the first enemy or box it touches, hitting up to 5 enemies or boxes in the blast.
The heavy attack is a charged shot that pushes you back.
Special attack: Charge Shot II. It fires two slower charged rockets that home like the others, and pushes you back. It costs no TP and cannot be chained from normal or heavy attacks.
Each charged rocket pierces the first 2 enemies or boxes it touches, then explodes in a big blast that hits up to 5 more.
On the way, each charged rocket sets off small explosions that hit up to 5 enemies or boxes.

008C08.name: 召唤毁灭法师
description: 普通攻击（仅魔法师职业）会在你身旁召唤一名友方毁灭法师，或派它攻击你指定的敌人。它拥有极限难度毁灭法师的属性，可从最远160单位处交替施放圣光术和死咒术，然后传送到目标附近。
召唤出的毁灭法师在100单位内时，若HP低于75%，它会改为对附近的召唤生物施放圣泉术；最多每12秒发动一次。
它会跟随你，并持续攻击房间内最近的敌人，直到被击败或你切换区域。被击败后，3秒即可再次召唤。每只召唤生物头上都会显示HP条；如果召唤生物挡住角色视线，会半透明显示。

source.name: Gran Sorcerer summon
description: Normal attack (Forces only) summons an ally Gran Sorcerer beside you, or sends it at the enemy you target. With an Ultimate Gran Sorcerer's stats it alternates Grants and Megid from up to 160 units, then teleports near its target.
When a summon within 100 units drops below 75% HP, it casts Resta on the summons near it instead, at most once every 12 seconds.

It follows you and fights the nearest enemy in the room until it is defeated or you change area. After a defeat you can summon again in 3 seconds. An HP bar shows over every summon, and a summon that blocks your view of your character turns half transparent.

000A08.name: TP回复
description: 装备期间，每0.1秒恢复最大TP的0.5%（每秒恢复5%）。

source.name: TP regeneration
description: While equipped, it restores 0.5% of maximum TP every 0.1 seconds (5% per second).

0102A8.name: 黑犬套装
description: 装备魂之传承、诫魂者或噬魂者时：攻击力+100、命中率+15，未触发即死的死咒术伤害提高20%。
装备黑色猎犬胸甲时：防御力+50。两项套装加成都可叠加。
装备魂之传承时，武器动作还会变为双头剑动作，特殊攻击变为十向死咒术。

source.name: Black Hound set
description: With Soul Tradicion, Soul Banish or Soul Eater equipped: +100 ATP, +15 ATA and 20% more damage from Megids that fail to kill.
With Black Hound Cuirass: +50 DFP. Both bonuses stack.
With Soul Tradicion it also gives the weapon double saber motions and a 10-way Megid special.

000909.name: 跳跃突进与爆破
description: 普通攻击和重攻击为近战挥击，可命中24单位范围内最多3个目标；从正面也能攻击Satellite Lizards。连击第一击会造成两次命中。
特殊攻击：向前跳跃突进，随后用尖刺尖端刺击并发射爆破，最多击中5名敌人或箱子；最近的目标受到重攻击伤害，其余目标受到一半伤害。
特殊攻击开始后的0.3秒内不会受到伤害，且不能接在其他攻击之后发动。

source.name: Jump dash and blast
description: Normal and heavy attacks are melee swings that hit up to 3 targets within 24 units, and they can strike Satellite Lizards from the front. The first swing of the combo hits twice.
Special: jump-dashes forward, then thrusts and fires a blast from the spike's tip that hits up to 5 enemies or boxes: the nearest takes heavy-attack damage, the others half.
You cannot be hurt for the first 0.3 seconds of the special, and it cannot be chained from other attacks.

030E29.name: 节拍滤镜
description: 对已装备的圣枪「天罚」、天堂冲击或天国呼啸使用，可使其神罚特殊攻击在任何节拍时刻都能发动。强化等级和属性百分比会保留；天堂冲击仍须装备冲击部件玛古。

source.name: Beat-time filter
description: Use it on an equipped Heaven Punisher, Heaven Striker or Mille Marteaux to make its Divine Punishment usable at every beat time. Grind and percentages are kept; Heaven Striker still needs a Striker Unit Mag.

000409.name: 投枪掷击
description: 普通攻击和重攻击使用长刀挥砍动作，并可照常衔接连击。
特殊攻击：投出长枪，最多贯穿5名敌人，并在每个命中点爆炸。每次爆炸最多击中5名敌人或箱子，命中率与重攻击相同；长枪直接命中的敌人受到重攻击威力伤害，其他目标受到一半伤害。
长枪撞墙时会以一半威力爆炸，然后飞回；接住长枪后即可再次攻击。

source.name: Javelin throw
description: Normal and heavy attacks are partisan swings and combo as usual.

Special: throws the spear. It pierces up to 5 enemies and explodes at each, and every blast hits up to 5 enemies and boxes with heavy-attack accuracy: the enemy the spear struck takes heavy-attack power, the others half.
A wall ends the throw with a blast at half power. The spear flies back, and you can attack again as soon as you catch it.

008C09.name: 召唤厄普西隆
description: 普通攻击（仅魔法师职业）会在你身旁召唤一台友方厄普西隆，或派它攻击你指定的敌人。它拥有极限难度厄普西隆的属性，并会对目标施放炎狱术。
施放3次后，它会打开4块护盾，持续6秒。护盾每秒最多击中每名敌人一次；只有护盾打开时它才会受到伤害。
它会跟随你，并持续攻击房间内最近的敌人，直到被击败或你切换区域。被击败后，3秒即可再次召唤。每只召唤生物头上都会显示HP条；如果召唤生物挡住角色视线，会半透明显示。

source.name: Epsilon summon
description: Normal attack (Forces only) summons an ally Epsilon beside you, or sends it at the enemy you target. With an Ultimate Epsilon's stats it casts Rafoie on its target.
After three casts it opens its four guards for 6 seconds. They hit each enemy they touch at most once a second, and it only takes damage while they are open.

It follows you and fights the nearest enemy in the room until it is defeated or you change area. After a defeat you can summon again in 3 seconds. An HP bar shows over every summon, and a summon that blocks your view of your character turns half transparent.

008F09.name: 浅蓝色波浪冲击
description: 特殊攻击：以最大TP的15%为代价，发射浅蓝色暗黑弗罗文大剑波浪：共5道贯穿波，每道最多击中5名敌人一次。TP低于该消耗量时无法使用；CAST的TP为0，因此无法发动。
普通攻击和重攻击每击中一名敌人，都会恢复最大TP的3%。
移动时，剑身会拖出白色剪影。
同时装备弗罗文之铠和弗罗文之盾时，精准防御会令武器化为更长的浅蓝色暗黑弗罗文大剑，持续20秒：攻击距离+50%，波浪冲击伤害提高30%，并且每0.1秒恢复最大TP的2%。

source.name: Light-blue wave crash
description: Special: Dark Flow's wave crash in light blue, for 15% of maximum TP: five waves that pierce, each hitting up to 5 enemies once. It is refused below that, so a CAST (0 TP) cannot use it.
Normal and heavy attacks restore 3% of maximum TP for each enemy they hit.
A white silhouette trails the sword while you move.

With Flowen's Frame and Flowen's Shield, a Just Guard wraps the sword in a longer light-blue Dark Flow blade for 20 seconds: attack reach +50%, the wave crash 30% stronger, and 2% of maximum TP restored every 0.1 seconds.

008F09.name: 弗罗文套装
description: 同时装备弗罗文之铠、弗罗文之盾和任意一把弗罗文大剑（原版、所有带日期的复制版或真品）时：每件装备自身的属性提高50%；大剑的攻击力与命中率、铠甲和盾牌的防御力与回避力均会提高。

source.name: Flowen set
description: Worn with Flowen's Frame, Flowen's Shield and any Flowen's Sword (the original, every dated replica or True): each piece's own stats are raised by 50%, the sword's ATP and ATA and the Frame's and the Shield's DFP and EVP.

00090A.name: 扩张式激光柱
description: 普通攻击和重攻击会发射一道粉色光束，射程130单位，可贯穿射线路径上的所有敌人和箱子；每个目标会在约0.33秒间隔内被击中3次，每次造成该次攻击伤害的三分之一。
特殊攻击：向前跃进并架设加农炮。三圈激光柱会从角色周围向外扩张，每圈最多击中范围内5名敌人或箱子一次，造成普通攻击一半的伤害。

source.name: Expanding laser pillars
description: Normal and heavy attacks fire a pink beam up to 130 units that pierces every enemy and box on its line, hitting each 3 times about 0.33 seconds apart for one-third of the attack's damage.
Special: leaps forward and plants the cannon. Three circles of laser pillars expand around you, and each circle hits up to 5 enemies or boxes inside it once for half of normal-attack damage.

00090A.name: 阿尔特拉套装
description: 同时装备阿尔特拉加农和杀手之光时：光束射程提升至步枪范围，三圈范围扩大一倍（36、68和100单位），特殊攻击每次命中造成普通攻击三分之一的伤害；特殊攻击每次造成伤害时，还有50%几率触发恶魔效果。

source.name: Altera set
description: With Altera Kanon and Murderer's Gleam also equipped: beams reach Rifle range, the circles double (36, 68 and 100 units), each special hit deals one-third of normal-attack damage, and each special hit that wounds has a 50% chance to also trigger Demon's.

008C0A.name: 召唤剑魔
description: 普通攻击（仅魔法师职业）会在你身旁召唤一名友方剑魔，或派它攻击你指定的敌人。它拥有极限难度剑魔的属性，并使用剑魔自身的攻击方式作战。
它会跟随你，并持续攻击房间内最近的敌人，直到被击败或你切换区域。被击败后，3秒即可再次召唤。每只召唤生物头上都会显示HP条；如果召唤生物挡住角色视线，会半透明显示。

source.name: Delsaber summon
description: Normal attack (Forces only) summons an ally Delsaber beside you, or sends it at the enemy you target. It has an Ultimate Delsaber's stats and fights with Delsaber's own attacks.

It follows you and fights the nearest enemy in the room until it is defeated or you change area. After a defeat you can summon again in 3 seconds. An HP bar shows over every summon, and a summon that blocks your view of your character turns half transparent.

030E2A.name: 欧米茄升级
description: 对已装备的混沌骑士枪使用，即可将其变为混沌骑士枪Ω。强化等级、特殊攻击和属性百分比都会保留。

source.name: Omega upgrade
description: Use it on an equipped Bringer's Rifle to turn it into Bringer Rifle (Omega). Grind, special and percentages are kept.

00040A.name: 火球齐射与燃烧弹
description: 普通攻击和重攻击会照常挥砍，同时根据你的精神力发射火球术：每次普通攻击命中发射1发Lv.15火球术；每次重攻击命中则以30度扇形发射3发Lv.3火球术。
特殊攻击：向四周发射8发Lv.20火球术，每发最多贯穿5名敌人，并在地面留下持续8秒的火焰。火焰中的敌人每0.5秒受到一次相当于普通攻击一半的伤害。
特殊攻击不能在连击中使用；装备期间法术伤害提高10%。

source.name: Foie volleys and napalm
description: Normal and heavy swings hit as usual and also fire Foie using your MST: one Lv.15 Foie per normal hit, or three Lv.3 Foie in a 30-degree fan per heavy hit.

Special: eight Lv.20 Foie fly out in all directions, each passing through up to 5 enemies, and leave burning ground for 8 seconds. Enemies in the fire take a hit every 0.5 seconds worth half a normal attack.
The special cannot be used inside a combo, and your techniques deal 10% more damage while it is equipped.

008C0B.name: 召唤雷暴巨猿
description: 普通攻击（仅魔法师职业）会在你身旁召唤一只友方雷暴巨猿，或派它攻击你指定的敌人。它拥有极限难度雷暴巨猿的属性，并使用雷暴巨猿自身的攻击方式作战。

source.name: Hildelt summon
description: Normal attack (Forces only) summons an ally Hildelt beside you, or sends it at the enemy you target. It has an Ultimate Hildelt's stats and fights with Hildelt's own attacks.

It follows you and fights the nearest enemy in the room until it is defeated or you change area. After a defeat you can summon again in 3 seconds. An HP bar shows over every summon, and a summon that blocks your view of your character turns half transparent.

00090B.name: 光束
description: 普通攻击和重攻击会沿地面发射快速光束，射程与步枪相同。光束可贯穿敌人和箱子，遇墙停止，也能击中会挡下枪弹的敌人（例如Satellite Lizards）。
光束沿途的光爆会额外击中最多5名敌人一次，造成光束伤害的50%。重攻击光束还会在地面留下持续2秒的尾迹，每0.25秒造成一次30%伤害。
特殊攻击：以40度扇形发射5发Lv.30冻气术；命中的敌人会被冻结，免疫冰冻的敌人除外。
重攻击和特殊攻击不能衔接连击；装备期间法术伤害提高10%。

source.name: Light beam
description: Normal and heavy attacks fire a fast light beam along the ground out to Rifle range. It pierces enemies and boxes, stops at walls, and can hit enemies that block gunfire, such as Satellite Lizards.
Light bursts along its path hit up to 5 enemies once more for 50% of the beam's damage. Heavy beams also leave a ground wake for 2 seconds that hits every 0.25 seconds for 30%.
Special: five Lv.30 Barta in a 40-degree fan freeze every enemy they hit, unless it is immune.
Heavy and special attacks cannot combo, and your techniques deal 10% more damage while it is equipped.

000A0B.name: 连枷旋舞
description: 普通攻击和重攻击会从远处挥动连枷攻击一名敌人。每次成功命中还会触发一道Lv.20炎狱术，对爆炸范围内最多5名敌人造成其通常威力的30%。
每次成功命中消耗最大TP的1%（向上取整）；即使TP为0仍可攻击。
特殊攻击：球锤会绕着你旋转3圈，持续2秒；每圈最多击中153单位范围内5名敌人，威力等同普通攻击。

source.name: Flail and spin
description: Normal and heavy attacks whip the flail at one enemy from a distance. Each landed hit also sets off a Lv.20 Rafoie that deals 30% of its usual damage to up to 5 enemies in the blast.
Each landed hit costs 1% of maximum TP, rounded up. You can still attack with no TP.
Special: the ball circles you three times over 2 seconds, and each turn hits up to 5 enemies within 153 units at normal-attack power.

000A0B.name: 巨人级/攻击++套装
description: 装备巨人级/攻击++时：武器命中造成的伤害提高20%，攻击法术伤害提高10%（包括炎狱术爆炸），每次成功命中消耗的最大TP由1%降至0.5%。巨人级/攻击和巨人级/攻击+不计入此套装效果。

source.name: Ogre/Power++ set
description: With Ogre/Power++ equipped: the weapon's hits deal 20% more damage, your attack techniques deal 10% more (its Rafoie blasts too), and each landed hit costs 0.5% of maximum TP instead of 1%. Ogre/Power and Ogre/Power+ do not count.

0102AB.name: 好运护符
description: 装备式神或式神「瑚式」时：命中率+25，火墙术、冰箭术、群雷术、炎狱术、极冰术和雷爆术造成的伤害提高25%。
装备式神「瑚式」时，其旋转光环持续时间额外延长15秒（单次攻击后持续20秒；持续攻击时最多剩余45秒），范围扩大至1.5倍（普通攻击为60单位，重攻击为90单位）。

source.name: Charms of good luck
description: With Hitogata or Dancing Hitogata equipped: +25 ATA, and Gifoie, Gibarta, Gizonde, Rafoie, Rabarta and Razonde deal 25% more damage.

With Dancing Hitogata, its spinning ring lasts 15 seconds longer (20 seconds from one attack, up to 45 seconds left when you keep attacking) and is 1.5x wider (60 units for normal attacks, 90 for heavy attacks).

008C0C.name: 召唤姬蜂
description: 普通攻击（仅魔法师职业）会在你身旁召唤一只友方姬蜂，或派它攻击你指定的敌人。它拥有极限难度姬蜂的属性，并使用姬蜂自身的攻击方式作战。

01015D.name: 波基亚基套装
description: 装备波基亚基时：波基亚基命中造成的伤害提高50%，所有攻击（包括特殊攻击）的速度加倍。
波基亚基每次击杀都会获得一层伤害加成：每层提高5%，最多叠加6层（共30%）。每次击杀都会将层数持续时间重置为30秒。
同时装备杀手之光时，可获得波基亚基的完整套装效果。

source.name: POKIAKI set
description: With POKIAKI equipped, POKIAKI's hits deal 50% more damage and its attacks, the special included, run twice as fast.
Each kill with POKIAKI adds 5% POKIAKI damage, up to 6 stacks (30%). Every kill resets the stacks to 30 seconds.
With Murderer's Gleam also equipped, POKIAKI gains its full-set bonus.

01036D.name: 波基亚基吸血
description: 无论是否装备波基亚基，技能冷却时间均缩短20%。该效果可与其他技能插件叠加，冷却缩减上限为80%。
装备波基亚基时，每次对敌人造成伤害的命中都会恢复最大HP的1.5%；每次击杀会增加10%波基亚基伤害，最多叠加5层（共50%）。每次击杀都会将层数持续时间重置为30秒。
同时装备阿尔特拉加农时，可获得波基亚基的完整套装效果。

source.name: POKIAKI lifesteal
description: Skill cooldowns are 20% shorter, with or without POKIAKI. This combines with other skill units up to the 80% cap.
With POKIAKI equipped, each hit that damages an enemy restores 1.5% of maximum HP, and each kill adds 10% POKIAKI damage, up to 5 stacks (50%). Every kill resets the stacks to 30 seconds.
With Altera Kanon also equipped, POKIAKI gains its full-set bonus.

008C0D.name: 召唤恶镰死神
description: 普通攻击（仅魔法师职业）会在你身旁召唤一名友方恶镰死神，或派它攻击你指定的敌人。它拥有极限难度恶镰死神的属性，并使用恶镰死神自身的攻击方式作战。

03100E.name: 战神长刀转换
description: 对已装备的长刀+35、护卫长刀+30、骑士长刀+25、将军长刀+20或战神长刀+10（或更高强化等级）使用，即可将其变为波鲁克斯冈格尼尔。属性百分比会保留；强化等级和特殊攻击会重置。

source.name: Gungnir conversion
description: Use it on an equipped Partisan +35, Halbert +30, Glaive +25, Berdys +20 or Gungnir +10 (or higher) to turn it into Pollux Gungnir. Percentages carry over; grind and special reset.

03100F.name: 军用散弹枪转换
description: 对已装备的散弹枪+20、重型散弹枪+20、加农散弹枪+15、强袭散弹枪+15或军用散弹枪+10（或更高强化等级）使用，即可将其变为卡斯托尔臂甲。属性百分比会保留；强化等级和特殊攻击会重置。

source.name: Arms conversion
description: Use it on an equipped Shot +20, Spread +20, Cannon +15, Launcher +15 or Arms +10 (or higher) to turn it into Castor Arms. Percentages carry over; grind and special reset.
